title: Block Social Apps and Keep Calls and Messages Available
description: Block distracting iPhone apps while keeping calls, messages and essential apps available. Test both blocked and allowed apps before setting a schedule.
direct: Select only the apps you intend to block, then test a distracting app and each essential app during a short session.
figureAlt: Realistic photograph of a hand reaching for a face-down smartphone beside a notebook and work keys at a quiet home office desk
cards.decision.heading: List your essential apps
cards.decision.body: Decide which apps you need during the block. Include Phone, Messages, transport or a work authenticator as applicable. Leave them out of the block. Check each member before selecting a whole category.
sections.detail-1.heading: Check what manages availability
sections.detail-1.body: Keep your existing Focus preferences in mind during the test. If one app remains closed or silent after your test block ends, review other restrictions that were already active.
sections.detail-2.heading: About the app
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops this iPhone app. Check the App Store listing for current access and export options.
faqs.first-question.heading: What if an app opens but its alerts are gone?
faqs.first-question.body: Review Focus and Screen Time separately. An available app can still have notifications silenced.
faqs.second-question.heading: What if I block an app by mistake?
faqs.second-question.body: Check temporary unlock options and correct the selection for the next session.

steps.step-1.text: In Dying Soon, choose the distracting apps individually.
steps.step-2.text: Start a thirty-minute Block Now session. Try one blocked app and each essential app. Make a test call or message if those need to work.
steps.step-3.text: Adjust the selection before relying on a recurring schedule. Test again if you change your routine or install an app that you need.
